title: Check the applied Marketplace and Tags popups

steps.path: Confirming the single-line file header you chose
steps.hint: Scroll inside the file to its last line; scroll outside to switch between Before and Applied. Open in New Window if you want the full file height.
steps.headline: Does the applied Marketplace file header match your choice?
steps.risk: The file text is sample data. The applied single-line title omits the plugin/type line; other Marketplace popups are unchanged.

variants.label: Before (for reference)
variants.summary: Original two-line header, 18px semibold filename, full-width divider and bare body.

variants.label: Applied file viewer
variants.summary: Actual one-line 16px medium filename, 8% divider and 42px/4%-side conditional content fade.

steps.path: Confirming the conditional fade you chose
steps.hint: Open each version in a New Window to see the full editor; shrink that window until its body scrolls, then compare the edge.
steps.headline: Does the applied Tags editor match your choice?
steps.risk: The fade is off when the body fits; on a short window, note controls near the bottom edge become faint until scrolled into view.

variants.label: Before (for reference)
variants.summary: Original 14px bold title, full-width divider and bare body.

variants.label: Applied Tags & note
variants.summary: Actual 16px medium title, 8% divider and 42px/4%-side fade only when the editor scrolls.
